Action.description: Action is a declared mutation of one object.

audit.description: Audit is the audit log key.

body.description: Body is the patch or object; its strings are templates (now, name, namespace, params.*).

confirm.description: Confirm is how the app confirms: none, plain, or the object's name typed.

disabledReason.description: DisabledReason is shown when EnabledWhen is false; a template.

enabledWhen.description: EnabledWhen is a boolean expression over the row's object.

method.description: Method is how verb subresource calls it: PUT (the default, as virtctl does), POST, or PATCH (a merge patch, as kubectl scale does).

on.description: On is the resource the action applies to.

params.description: Params are typed inputs, available to the body as params.<name>.

propagationPolicy.description: PropagationPolicy is verb delete's: what happens to the object's dependents.

rbac.description: RBAC is what the account needs; it becomes a can-I check.

subresource.description: Subresource is the subresource of verb subresource (start, scale…).

verb.description: Verb is how the object is changed.

Card.description: Card is the summary card or a list card.

empty.description: Empty is the text shown when there is no row.

from.description: From is the resource or data service (dataServices.<name>) a list card shows, one row per element.

row.description: Row is one row of a list card.

sort.description: Sort orders the rows: expressions, each optionally followed by asc or desc.

title.description: Title is the summary's title: an expression, or a count with singular and plural.

Column.description: Column is one column of a table.

DataService.description: DataService is derived data: aggregate over resources, or from + groupBy + aggregate, or from + where + select.

aggregate.description: Aggregate are named values: count(res), count(res, pred), sum/min/max(res, expr), worst(res.health); with groupBy, count(), count(pred), sum(expr)…

from.description: From is the resource the data service walks.

groupBy.description: GroupBy is the key of each group (one row per key).

health.description: Health is the data service's health, e.g. worst(sleepinfo.health).

select.description: Select projects each kept object into named values.

where.description: Where keeps the objects it holds for.

Detect.description: Detect is one way to tell the product is installed: an API group (with a resource when the group is shared), running pods of an app catalog id, or a Prometheus-style service.

group.description: Group is an API group served by the cluster (GET /apis).

pods.description: Pods is the app catalog id of running pods.

resource.description: Resource must be served too, for a group several products share.

service.description: Service is a service kind matched by name.

Finding.description: Finding is a problem the checkup and the monitor report, one per matching object.

from.description: From is the resource whose objects are tested.

opens.description: Opens is the card the finding links to.

title.description: Title is a template (name, namespace, message, reason, fields.*).

when.description: When is a boolean expression over the object, its fields and health.

HealthRule.description: HealthRule sets an object's health when its condition holds.

health.description: Health is the tone the object takes.

message.description: Message explains the health; a template.

reason.description: Reason is a stable id the apps may map to a string.

when.description: When is a boolean expression over the object and its fields.

Item.description: Item is a keyValues, badges or relations entry, or an action id (a plain string) in an actions section.

oneOf.description: An action id (in an actions section).
Item is a keyValues, badges or relations entry, or an action id (a plain string) in an actions section.

hideWhenZero.description: HideWhenZero drops a badge whose value is 0.

on.description: On lights a badge (ok) or dims it (idle).

ref.description: Ref is the related object (relations): an object, as join() returns.

text.description: Text replaces the related object's name (relations).

tone.description: A tone (ok, idle, info, warning, critical, unknown) or an expression that evaluates to one.

value.description: Value is the shown value (keyValues, badges).

limit.description: Limit is the page size (0 or absent is 500).

metadataOnly.description: MetadataOnly reads each object's metadata alone (PartialObjectMetadata): a Secret's values, or a large spec, never leave the API server.

Param.description: Param is a typed input of an action.

values.description: Values are the choices of an enum.

RBAC.description: RBAC is the permission an action needs.

Resource.description: Resource is a kind the plugin lists.

group.description: Group is the API group, "" for the core group.

list.description: List narrows and pages the list call.

optional.description: Optional is a resource the plugin does without (a decorative relation): forbidden or not served, it reads as empty with no error.

resource.description: Resource is the plural resource name (sleepinfos).

reveal.description: Reveal shows a Secret's data; it stays masked otherwise.

source.description: Source is native:<id> to read through a Go reader instead of a list call.

version.description: Version is the API version, or preferred for the group's preferred version.

watch.description: Watch refreshes the plugin screen on watch events.

Row.description: Row is one row of a list card.

detail.description: Detail are the sections shown when the row is expanded.

Section.description: Section is a primitive of a row's detail; which keys apply depends on its type.

from.description: From is the data service (dataServices.<name>) or resource a table walks.

items.description: Items are the rows of keyValues, badges and relations, and the action ids of actions.

mono.description: Mono sets a text in a monospace font.

text.description: Text is a text section's template, or a gauge's caption.

tone.description: Tone colors a gauge or a text.

unit.description: Unit formats a gauge's value: bytes, percent, or a word.

Status.description: Status is a row's colored status.

tone.description: A tone (ok, idle, info, warning, critical, unknown) or an expression that evaluates to one.

Title.description: Title is an expression, or {count, one, other}: "%d" in one and other is the count.

oneOf.description: Title is an expression, or {count, one, other}: "%d" in one and other is the count.

Trailing.description: Trailing is the text at a row's end.

actions.description: Actions are declared mutations, by id.

cards.description: Cards are what the apps show: summary (the tile and the hub header) and list cards.

catalogId.description: CatalogID is the app catalog id used to detect the product from its pods.

category.description: Category picks the hub that lists the plugin (default data-services).

dataServices.description: DataServices are derived data (aggregations, groupings, projections), by name, in order.

detect.description: Detect activates the plugin when any entry matches.

fields.description: Fields are named expressions per resource, evaluated per object in order; a field may use the earlier ones as fields.<name>.

findings.description: Findings feed the cluster checkup and the background monitor.

health.description: Health are the rules per resource; the first matching rule wins, and an object no rule matches is ok.

i18n.description: I18n maps an English label to its translation, per locale; a missing label stays English.

icon.description: Icon is an app catalog id (assets/appicons).

id.description: ID is unique across built-in and user plugins: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

name.description: Name is the product name, a proper noun, never translated.

resources.description: Resources are the kinds the plugin reads, by local name (the key used everywhere else).

samples.description: Samples are demo objects per resource, in the API's shape: the demo context and the tests render them.

schemaVersion.description: SchemaVersion is ichor.dev/plugin/v1alpha1; the loader refuses another major version.

screen.description: Screen is native:<route> to open a native screen from the hub tile; empty is the generic plugin screen.

website.description: Website is the project's home page.
